source: Live probe 2026-11-20: IRelationship.setFrom/setTo for every pair of probed end types (ADR-0040). VP refuses a pair with 'Invalid connection. <type> is not allowed with <rel>'.

RQTrace.use: trace any element to the requirement it relates to

Satisfy.use: an element (often a use case or block) satisfies a requirement

Verify.use: a test case (or other element) verifies a requirement

RequirementDerive.use: a requirement derived from another (SysML deriveReqt)

Association.use: association (actor to use case, class to class)

Generalization.use: inheritance between elements of the same kind

Include.use: «include» between use cases (from the including one)

Extend.use: «extend» between use cases (from the base one; VP draws the arrowhead there)

not_in_vp.Trace: VP 18.1 has no Trace relationship: use RQTrace (target a Requirement) or Abstraction.
not_in_vp.Refine: VP 18.1 has no Refine relationship: use Abstraction with a «refine» stereotype.
not_in_vp.Containment: VP 18.1 has no Containment relationship: nest with create_element container.
